title.zh: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam Upgrade Activates on Sepolia
title.en: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam Upgrade Activates on Sepolia

current_state.zh: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade went live on the Sepolia testnet, finalizing its first two upgraded epochs while the gas limit began a gradual climb from 60 million toward a 200 million client target.
current_state.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade went live on the Sepolia testnet, finalizing its first two upgraded epochs while the gas limit began a gradual climb from 60 million toward a 200 million client target.
